inconclusive_journey.why: work that concludes without a positive finding, replayable with its history intact — Phase C's gate

conclude_from_proposed.reason: mission-program/investigation/default@1 does not permit PROPOSED -> CONCLUDED as 'conclude_inconclusive'

duplicate_sequence.reason: two events share sequence 0; ordering is not reconstructible

private_evidence_on_public_event.reason: investigation/regime-features-leak-future-state@1: a public event cites private artifacts ['mission/my-plan@1']

resume_without_pause.reason: history is not contiguous: at ASSIGNED, next event moves from PAUSED

terminal_state_without_outcome.reason: investigation/regime-features-leak-future-state@1: entered terminal state 'CONCLUDED' with no outcome recorded

two_terminal_transitions.reason: a second terminal transition follows one that already ended the inquiry

wrong_program_version.reason: investigation/regime-features-leak-future-state@1: this event pinned program rcv1:00000000000… and was checked against rcv1:8b83560a4da…. Permission derived from the wrong program is not permission

invalid_workflows.why: a rejection must be a typed reason, not a generic schema error — 'conclude from PROPOSED' and 'malformed payload' must not look alike

order_variation_replays_identically.why: insertion order is a property of the caller, not the history

outcome_changes_identity.why: replacing INCONCLUSIVE with FINDING_PRODUCED is a different history, and one of them emits a public artifact

program.why: the pinned lifecycle every transition is checked against

prose_and_time_excluded.why: the same transition, reworded or re-clocked, is the same fact
